nodes.label: Deploy Trigger: Push to main branch
nodes.rationale: Auto-deploy on push to main plus manual workflow_dispatch; .md, .archive/**, docs/** changes are ignored to avoid unnecessary redeploys.

nodes.label: Deploy Concurrency Guard
nodes.rationale: Concurrency group per github.ref with cancel-in-progress:true prevents parallel deploys racing on the same ref.

nodes.label: Lint Step: Biome (continue-on-error for young codebase)
nodes.rationale: continue-on-error:true on lint so lint warnings don't block deploy while codebase is young; typecheck is blocking.

nodes.label: Variable Font Weight Tied to Scroll Velocity

nodes.label: Single R3F Scene: Low-poly globe on /journey (Kyiv+Jakarta pins)

nodes.label: Layout Grammar: Asymmetric 12-col grid, diagonal clip-paths, sticky elements
nodes.rationale: Never 6/6 split — always asymmetric 7/5, 8/4, 5/7. Diagonal clip-paths for section transitions. Hero overlaps fold by 8vh for depth.
nodes.norm_label: layout grammar: asymmetric 12-col grid, diagonal clip-paths, sticky elements

nodes.label: i18n Strategy: 4 locales (EN/UK/RU/ID), locale-differentiated content not translation
nodes.rationale: Each locale has different LEAD content, not line-by-line translation. ~70% shared + ~30% locale-specific. Stored as separate MDX files. Switcher preserves scroll position, localStorage remembers preference but URL is source of truth.
nodes.norm_label: i18n strategy: 4 locales (en/uk/ru/id), locale-differentiated content not translation
